admission.justification: Weighed the 8-pillar 41-landmark condensed architecture with bounded nearest-landmark import projection against preserving the legacy 21-stage layout, symbol-matched edges or Lake elaboration, constraining all Stage 01-07 explainer leaves and future pin advances.

alternatives.option: Align dag/stage-map.json to the 8 condensed mathematical pillars (00_statement plus 01_reduction through 07_congruences), map 41 landmarks (3 live Stage 00 files with preserve_defs=true on Statements/Challenge and false on Main, plus 38 src/New/ landmarks across Stages 01-07 with preserve_defs=false), harden closed-world default-deny Lean parsing across all 305 src/New/ files, keep build_dag direct-import by default, and compute DAG depends_on edges in extract_and_write via bounded BFS nearest-landmark import projection strictly through unmapped upstream src/ and root .lean headers.
alternatives.reason: Matches the live condensed readable edition's 8-pillar src/New/ structure while preserving a dedicated Alpoge 20-step historical map page, keeps Stage 00 formal definitions inspectable verbatim, fails closed on unsupported syntax, eliminates isolated DAG nodes via real upstream import chains without inventing symbol-matched edges, and stays pure-Python deterministic.
